title: My Robot Birthday
text: Today is my birthday, and my family planned a surprise party for me! When I woke up, I found a big gift box next to my bed. Inside was a toy robot! I was so happy that I took a photo with it right away. At the party, my friends brought flowers and a card in the mail. We drank juice from a bottle and had so much fun. My uncle even gave me a ticket to the robot museum for next weekend. After the party, I helped clean up and took out the trash. My mom said learning a new word every day is a good habit, so I wrote "robot" as my word of the day. That night, I had a wonderful dream about riding my new robot down the way to school!
